newsitem.title: ST LUCIA: Mass manhunt on St Lucia after prison break.
newsitem.headline: Mass manhunt on St Lucia after prison break.

text.p: St. Lucia authorities called police officers back from vacation on Friday to hunt for 11 convicts who escaped from jail.

The fugitives, who bore their way through a wall at a temporary prison on Thursday, were behind bars for murder, rape, armed robbery and drug possession and police said they should be considered extremely dangerous.

The Caribbean island has been forced to house prisoners in an abandoned factory for two months, since fires during a riot over poor conditions in St. Lucia's main prison forced much of that building to be shut down.
Since then, St. Lucia has been plagued by prison breaks, mostly from the abandoned factory in Odsan, a residential community about 12 miles (19 km) east of the capital.
Authorities assured islanders they were doing everything possible to catch the fugitives and beef up security at the temporary prison.

"The Commissioner (of police) is treating this matter very seriously and has cancelled all vacation leave to provide the force with maximum strength," Assistant Superintendent Ausbert Regis told the Caribbean News Agency.
